name: arm-reach-kr240

jobs.name: gpu-info
jobs.command: nvidia-smi | tee gpu-info.txt && nvcc --version | tee -a gpu-info.txt

jobs.name: build-arm-kr240
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; mkdir -p experimental/duck_cuda/build-arm-kr240; nvcc -std=c++17 -O3 --fmad=false -gencode arch=compute_89,code=sm_89 -gencode arch=compute_120,code=sm_120 -Iarm/include/kr240 -Iexperimental/duck_cuda/include -Xcompiler -fPIC -shared experimental/duck_cuda/src/duck_cuda.cu -o experimental/duck_cuda/build-arm-kr240/libarm_kr240_cuda.so 2>&1 | tee build-arm-kr240.log; g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -ffp-contract=off -Iarm/include/kr240 -Iexperimental/duck_cuda/include -fPIC -shared experimental/duck_cuda/src/duck_cuda_serial.cpp -o experimental/duck_cuda/build-arm-kr240/libarm_kr240_cuda_serial.so 2>&1 | tee -a build-arm-kr240.log; ls -la experimental/duck_cuda/build-arm-kr240 | tee -a build-arm-kr240.log

jobs.name: train
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; PY=$(command -v python3); $PY -c 'import numpy' 2>/dev/null || $PY -m pip install --quiet numpy; $PY -B -m walk.train.gpu_train --robot arm --variant kr240 --envs 4096 --horizon 64 --updates 99999 --seed 917 --device cuda --library experimental/duck_cuda/build-arm-kr240/libarm_kr240_cuda.so --policy ff --out gpu-train-out --lr 3e-4 --max-wall-s 900 2>&1 | tee gpu-train.log

jobs.name: acceptance
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; PY=$(command -v python3); $PY -B -m walk.eval.arm_acceptance --variant kr240 --actor gpu-train-out/actor_final.pt --lane serial --library experimental/duck_cuda/build-arm-kr240/libarm_kr240_cuda_serial.so --out acceptance-out 2>&1 | tee acceptance.log

notes: Arm obs/reward run PYTHON-SIDE over dwc1_step (no --lane-env: the kernel's device policy layer cannot express the arm's obs; arm/FEASIBILITY.md section 6). GPU physics per policy step = 1 dwc1_step launch + 1 dwc1_read body_state readback [E,8,13] f32.
